subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Should the Feishu multi-bot mention fix proceed with a proven union_id source, use another cross-app bot identity strategy, or wait for broader Feishu multi-bot identity work?
rationale: The current branch depends on an identity source contradicted by official docs and issue discussion, and it changes Feishu message admission where a wrong identity contract can drop or misroute group messages.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework this PR on current main only after proving the stable Feishu bot identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Feishu Work
options.body: Keep this PR as investigation context while a broader Feishu multi-bot identity PR owns the final routing and proof.

options.title: Accept Narrow union_id Direction
options.body: Maintainers may accept a union_id fallback only with explicit API proof, tests, and live multi-bot evidence that it populates reliably.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework this PR on current main only after proving the stable Feishu bot identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned, requested changes on this exact PR, and identified the Feishu identity conflict as non-mechanical.
